Two recent jobs, from how they started to how they were left.

Before → After
Re-Roof

Stripped Back and Re-Tiled

Worked from scaffold, the roof was stripped and covered in new membrane and battens, then laid in new grey tiles and capped with a matching ridge.

Before After
Roof Replacement

Tired Old Slates Replaced

The old slates had weathered and gathered moss, with gaps opening up along the slope. The roof was stripped and covered in new slates, finished straight and clean up to the ridge.
